title: Fish Assassin Charters

services.name: Fishing Types
services.desc: You’ll be fishing aboard the “Fish Assassin,” a 24’ Blazer Bay center console boat. The boat runs on a 250 HP Yamaha 4-stroke engine, and it’s the perfect vessel for small groups and family trips. The bow of the boat is equipped with an I-pilot trolling motor for shallow waters. The Fish Assassin has all the gear to stay on course and to have a trip to remember! (1-3 people) (4th person +$50)Looking for a well-rounded fishing experience? Our 6-hour trips are a great choice for anglers of all levels.
